_intent: What you can ACTUALLY pick, which is rarely the whole catalogue. Org policy, plan tier and preview gating all remove models, and a role whose entire fallback chain is blocked resolves to whatever the host substitutes instead. Recording availability here lets the build drop unreachable models from every agent and warn when a role has nothing good left.
_how_to_fill: Open VS Code, press Ctrl+Alt+. to show the model picker, and record exactly what it lists. Then run scripts/set-availability.ps1 -Preset work -Mode allow with -Models or -FromFile. There is no reliable API for this: entitlement depends on your plan and your admin's policy, so the picker is the only ground truth.
_modes: all = no filtering, use the whole catalogue. allow = only the listed models exist for this profile. deny = everything except the listed models.

personal.note: Personal Copilot plan - assumed unrestricted until recorded otherwise.

work.note: NOT YET RECORDED. Until this is filled in, the work preset routes to models your org may have blocked. Run scripts/set-availability.ps1 -Preset work -Mode allow with what your VS Code model picker actually shows.
